title: What Is E.S.G., and Why Are Republicans So Mad About It?

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日》节目。

sentences.en: In the coming days, President Biden will issue the first veto of his presidency in defense of an investment philosophy that many Americans have never heard of.
sentences.zh: 未来几天，拜登总统将行使他任内的首次否决权，以捍卫一种许多美国人从未听说过的投资理念。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague David Gellis on why that philosophy has become so controversial.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事大卫·盖利斯将为我们解读为何这一理念会引发如此大的争议。

sentences.en: It's Monday, March 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月13日，星期一。

sentences.en: David, it hasn't happened yet.
sentences.zh: 大卫，这件事还没发生。

sentences.en: But when I imagined President Biden's first legislative veto, not that I stay up late at night imagining it, but to the degree I ever had,
sentences.zh: 但当我设想拜登总统首次行使立法否决权时——并不是说我大半夜不睡觉去想这个，但如果我确实想过的话——

sentences.en: I imagined it would be a rejection of a big social proposal from Republicans, maybe something related to abortion or a cherished Democratic program.
sentences.zh: 我原以为那会是对共和党重大社会提案的否决，或许是与堕胎有关，又或是针对某项民主党珍视的计划。

sentences.en: And instead, we now expect Biden to wield his first veto pen to defend an acronym that I'm going to be honest, I haven't really ever heard of before.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们现在预计拜登将动用他的第一支否决笔，去捍卫一个说实话我以前从未听说过的缩写词。

sentences.en: E-S-G.
sentences.zh: E-S-G.

sentences.en: It is not what most people had on their bingo cards.
sentences.zh: 这不在大多数人的预料之中。

sentences.en: The fact that Biden's first veto would be about this arcane investing philosophy that has sort of out of nowhere become this political lightning rod.
sentences.zh: 拜登的首次否决权竟然与这种晦涩难懂、却不知从何处突然变成政治避雷针的投资理念有关。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: No, wasn't on my bingo card.
sentences.zh: 确实不在我的预料之中。

sentences.en: So just to get this out of the way, what is E-S-G?
sentences.zh: 那么，为了把问题说清楚，ESG到底是什么？

sentences.en: What is this investment philosophy?
sentences.zh: 这究竟是一种什么样的投资理念？

sentences.en: E-S-G is one of these acronyms that Wall Street comes up with to explain what it is they think they're trying to do.
sentences.zh: ESG是华尔街为了解释他们自认为在做的事情而发明的一系列缩写词之一。

sentences.en: The E stands for environmental priorities.
sentences.zh: E代表环境优先事项。

sentences.en: That's things like reducing carbon emissions.
sentences.zh: 比如减少碳排放。

sentences.en: The S stands for social factors.
sentences.zh: S代表社会因素。

sentences.en: That is things like good labor policies and improving diversity in the workplace.
sentences.zh: 比如良好的劳工政策和改善职场多元化。

sentences.en: And the G is for governance.
sentences.zh: G代表治理。

sentences.en: That is good corporate governance, making sure a corporation's house is in order and that their executive compensation policies are best in class.
sentences.zh: 即良好的公司治理，确保公司内部管理有序，且高管薪酬政策处于行业领先水平。

sentences.en: And all of this was invented as a way to essentially make sure that companies were not just doing
sentences.zh: 所有这些被发明出来，本质上是为了确保公司不仅能为投资者谋利，照顾好底线，

sentences.en: right for investors and taking care of their bottom line, but also taking care of all these
sentences.zh: 同时也能兼顾过去几十年来人们认为公司应该关注的那些

sentences.en: sort of softer issues that people have decided companies ought to be paying attention to over the last couple of decades.
sentences.zh: 更为柔性的议题。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, that timeframe of two decades or so makes me want to understand exactly where E-S-G comes from.
sentences.zh: 那么，这二十年左右的时间跨度让我很想了解ESG到底源自何处。

sentences.en: What's the origin story behind this?
sentences.zh: 它的起源故事是什么？

sentences.en: Well, the term itself has been around since 2004, but it really isn't until the years after the financial crisis that it starts picking up steam.
sentences.zh: 这个术语本身从2004年就出现了，但直到金融危机之后，它才真正开始流行起来。

sentences.en: And you have to remember that the financial crisis, especially here in the United States, was this traumatic event.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，金融危机，尤其是在美国，是一场创伤性事件。

sentences.en: Millions of homeowners saw their savings and their assets wiped out.
sentences.zh: 数百万房主眼睁睁看着自己的积蓄和资产化为乌有。

sentences.en: Big banks were bailed out by the government.
sentences.zh: 大银行得到了政府的救助。

sentences.en: None of the people responsible seemed to go to jail.
sentences.zh: 而那些负有责任的人似乎没有一个进了监狱。

sentences.en: There is fresh evidence that Americans are increasingly angry at Wall Street, at Washington, and more.
sentences.zh: 有新的证据表明，美国人对华尔街、华盛顿等机构越来越愤怒。

sentences.en: And there was a real sense of betrayal by the American public.
sentences.zh: 美国公众有一种强烈的被背叛感。

sentences.en: Whose side are you on?
sentences.zh: 你站在哪一边？

sentences.en: Main Street or Wall Street and the big corporations?
sentences.zh: 是站在普通民众一边，还是站在华尔街和大公司一边？

sentences.en: Trust will be Wall Street's issue for a long time to come.
sentences.zh: 信任问题将长期困扰华尔街。

sentences.en: In the wake of that, Wall Street, and big business in particular, needed sort of a rebranding.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，华尔街，尤其是大企业，需要进行某种品牌重塑。

sentences.en: And lots of new narratives came to the fore.
sentences.zh: 于是许多新的叙事浮出水面。

sentences.en: There used to be a myth that you couldn't do well and do good at the same time.
sentences.zh: 过去有一种迷思，认为你不可能在赚钱的同时又做好事。

sentences.en: You certainly know the role that corporate Americans can play when they put their mind to things.
sentences.zh: 你当然知道美国企业在下定决心时能发挥的作用。

sentences.en: There was CSR.
sentences.zh: 当时有了企业社会责任（CSR）。

sentences.en: They are starting with their own CSR operations, corporate social responsibility.
sentences.zh: 他们开始从自己的CSR业务入手，即企业社会责任。

sentences.en: For corporate social responsibility, people started talking about DEI.
sentences.zh: 对于企业社会责任，人们开始谈论DEI。

sentences.en: The issue is not finding diverse candidates.
sentences.zh: 问题不在于找不到多元化的候选人。

sentences.en: It's making sure that they have access to hiring.
sentences.zh: 而在于确保他们有平等的就业机会。

sentences.en: Diversity, equity, and inclusion.
sentences.zh: 即多元、公平和包容。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, there's a process in investment called ESG.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，投资领域有一种叫ESG的流程。

sentences.en: And that's really catching on with investors right now.
sentences.zh: 这在投资者中非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: ESG emerges as this sort of influential umbrella term.
sentences.zh: ESG作为一种颇具影响力的统称应运而生。

sentences.en: This is the sort of work that we do at our institution.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在我们机构所做的工作。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: ESG.
sentences.zh: ESG。

sentences.en: ESG.
sentences.zh: ESG。

sentences.en: ESG.
sentences.zh: ESG。

sentences.en: There's too many letters in here.
sentences.zh: 这里的字母太多了。

sentences.en: What's ESG?
sentences.zh: ESG是什么？

sentences.en: ESG is Environmental, Social, and Governance Standards.
sentences.zh: ESG是环境、社会和治理标准的缩写。

sentences.en: It's the Uber acronym that encompasses all of these other efforts that businesses seem to be pursuing to do right, not just for their investors, but for society too.
sentences.zh: 这是一个超级缩写词，涵盖了企业为不仅对投资者负责，也对社会负责而追求的所有其他努力。

sentences.en: There are about seven different areas that we look at.
sentences.zh: 我们关注的领域大约有七个。

sentences.en: The environment, diversity practices.
sentences.zh: 环境、多元化实践等。

sentences.en: A lot of these issues are things that companies believe they can measure.
sentences.zh: 许多这类议题是公司认为可以量化的。

sentences.en: For example, companies can track how much pollution and waste they're putting out there.
sentences.zh: 例如，公司可以追踪他们排放了多少污染和废物。

sentences.en: They can measure their gender and diversity policies.
sentences.zh: 他们可以衡量自己的性别和多元化政策。

sentences.en: And they can tell you how much employees on balance are making and how that's affecting things like income inequality at the country at large.
sentences.zh: 他们还可以告诉你员工的平均薪酬是多少，以及这如何影响整个国家的收入不平等问题。

sentences.en: And so it creates the framework for a real industry that is able to start measuring just how good different companies are doing on their ESG journeys.
sentences.zh: 因此，它为一个真正的行业创造了框架，能够开始衡量不同公司在ESG之旅中做得有多好。

sentences.en: I think there's hope that every company can have a very strong environmental social governance profile.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们希望每家公司都能拥有非常强大的环境、社会和治理形象。

sentences.en: David, as admirable as all those measurable metrics might be, there are plenty of investors who just want to make money.
sentences.zh: 大卫，尽管这些可衡量的指标令人钦佩，但仍有许多投资者只想赚钱。

sentences.en: They don't care whether the corporation they're buying stock in or the fund that they're buying shares of has diversity or cares about the environment.
sentences.zh: 他们并不关心他们购买股票的公司或持有的基金是否具有多元化，也不关心它是否关注环境。

sentences.en: So isn't that a significant limitation on this philosophy?
sentences.zh: 那么，这难道不是该理念的一个重大局限吗？

sentences.en: That is certainly an argument many of ESG's critics make.
sentences.zh: 这当然是许多ESG批评者提出的论点。

sentences.en: But here's the jujitsu of ESG, right?
sentences.zh: 但这就是ESG的柔术，对吧？

sentences.en: ESG proponents would tell you that not only are a lot of these things that ESG is paying attention to good for the world, but they're actually good for business in the long term.
sentences.zh: ESG的支持者会告诉你，ESG所关注的许多事情不仅对世界有益，而且从长远来看对商业也有利。

sentences.en: This strategy's proponents will tell you that it's good long term investing for companies to wean themselves off fossil fuels because the science is clear society needs to stop burning fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 该策略的支持者会告诉你，公司摆脱化石燃料是长期的良好投资，因为科学很明确，社会需要停止燃烧化石燃料。

sentences.en: So the companies that are further along in that journey, they say, are going to be better investments.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说，在这一进程中走得更远的公司，将成为更好的投资对象。

sentences.en: Similarly, on the diversity side, many people would argue that more diverse corporations that are reflective of the broad and diverse population that is the United States,
sentences.zh: 同样，在多元化方面，许多人会争辩说，更多元化的公司能够反映美国广泛而多元的人口结构，

sentences.en: for example, are going to be better suited to meet the needs and consumer demands of an increasingly diverse marketplace.
sentences.zh: 例如，它们将更适合满足日益多元化的市场需求和消费者要求。

sentences.en: And all of this reinforces this broader point that proponents of ESG make, which is that this isn't just about doing the right thing for the world or the right thing for society,
sentences.zh: 所有这些都强化了ESG支持者提出的更广泛观点，即这不仅仅是为了对世界或社会做正确的事，

sentences.en: that at the end of the day, all of this is good for business.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这一切对商业都有好处。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: OK, so how widely adopted does this ESG philosophy become?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么ESG理念的采纳程度有多广？

sentences.en: It's really hard to find a company these days that doesn't lean in to ESG at some level.
sentences.zh: 如今很难找到一家不在某种程度上倾向于ESG的公司。

sentences.en: Apple has a plan and a promise to make every single Apple product carbon neutral by 2030.
sentences.zh: 苹果公司有一个计划和承诺，要在2030年实现每一款苹果产品碳中和。

sentences.en: Even yours.
sentences.zh: 连你的也是。

sentences.en: Apple, Nike.
sentences.zh: 苹果、耐克。

sentences.en: Respect for human rights is embedded in Walmart's core values.
sentences.zh: 尊重人权已融入沃尔玛的核心价值观。

sentences.en: Walmart, Walgreens, Target.
sentences.zh: 沃尔玛、沃尔格林、塔吉特。

sentences.en: Here at Target, we've had a longstanding commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.
sentences.zh: 在塔吉特，我们长期致力于多元、公平和包容。

sentences.en: All of these companies have big operations where they're pursuing their ESG goals and telling the world about it.
sentences.zh: 所有这些公司都有庞大的业务，他们在追求ESG目标并向世界宣传。

sentences.en: Our efforts are making a difference in our stores and our communities.
sentences.zh: 我们的努力正在我们的门店和社区中产生影响。

sentences.en: And it's not only the companies that are doing it themselves.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是公司自己在做。

sentences.en: From this emerges a whole cottage industry of ratings agencies, companies like Bloomberg and Dow Jones and Thomson Reuters, S&P Global, Moody's, who'd start issuing ESG scores.
sentences.zh: 由此产生了一个完整的评级机构产业，像彭博、道琼斯、汤森路透、标普全球、穆迪这样的公司，开始发布ESG评分。

sentences.en: And then with those scores, fund managers,
sentences.zh: 有了这些评分，基金经理们，

sentences.en: that is big institutional investors that buy these big chunks of companies and put them in portfolios that retirement funds that invest in, they start creating ESG funds.
sentences.zh: 也就是购买大量公司股票并将其放入养老基金投资组合的大型机构投资者，开始创建ESG基金。

sentences.en: So that the biggest investment firms in the world, BlackRock, Vanguard, these titans of finance,
sentences.zh: 因此，世界上最大的投资公司，如贝莱德、先锋集团，这些金融巨头，

sentences.en: are now increasingly putting their money into an ESG strategy that is taking up more and more of the assets under their management,
sentences.zh: 现在越来越多地将资金投入到ESG策略中，这占据了他们管理资产中越来越大的比例，

sentences.en: as much as $18 trillion in the last couple of years.
sentences.zh: 过去几年高达18万亿美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a huge amount of money and very clearly suggests that this is a widespread, meaningful movement within American business right now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一笔巨额资金，非常清楚地表明这目前是美国商业界一场广泛且意义深远的运动。

sentences.en: It's become a huge deal.
sentences.zh: 它已经变得非常重要。

sentences.en: But even as it is becoming just ubiquitous in the corporate world, it's not without its critics.
sentences.zh: 但即使它在企业界变得无处不在，它也并非没有批评者。

sentences.en: There are those who dispute the degree to which they see it sort of prioritizing certain social and political issues they might not agree with.
sentences.zh: 有些人质疑它在多大程度上优先考虑了某些他们可能不同意的社会和政治议题。

sentences.en: And there are those who just dispute this premise that it's actually a good long-term investment to pursue these policies.
sentences.zh: 还有些人只是质疑追求这些政策实际上是长期良好投资这一前提。

sentences.en: And over the last couple of years, we've seen those critics get organized and go on the offensive.
sentences.zh: 在过去几年里，我们看到这些批评者组织起来并开始反击。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: David, tell us that story of ESG's opponents.
sentences.zh: 大卫，给我们讲讲ESG反对者的故事。

sentences.en: I think one of the most crucial moments in the backlash against ESG comes about three years ago, right around the start of the pandemic,
sentences.zh: 我认为ESG反弹中最关键的时刻之一发生在三年前，就在疫情开始前后，

sentences.en: when independent oil producers, small drillers in Texas, find themselves going to the usual banks that they've worked with for decades now,
sentences.zh: 当时德克萨斯州的独立石油生产商、小型钻探商发现自己去找几十年来一直合作的银行，

sentences.en: JPMorgan Chase among them, and saying, hey, we'd like some money for continued operations, a little more money for new exploration.
sentences.zh: 其中包括摩根大通，说，嘿，我们需要一些资金来维持运营，再多一点钱用于新的勘探。

sentences.en: And the banks say, actually, we're not going to give you the money this time because we don't necessarily believe that further oil exploration is a good long-term investment.
sentences.zh: 银行却说，实际上，这次我们不会给你们钱，因为我们不一定认为进一步的石油勘探是长期的良好投资。

sentences.en: We have concerns about the ability of these companies to pay back their loans over time.
sentences.zh: 我们担心这些公司长期偿还贷款的能力。

sentences.en: Now, what the oil men hear is that JPMorgan's not lending us money because they're turning their back on fossil fuels full stop.
sentences.zh: 现在，石油商们听到的是，摩根大通不借钱给我们，是因为他们彻底背弃了化石燃料。

sentences.en: And they start complaining.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始抱怨。

sentences.en: They start complaining to the Texas state legislature.
sentences.zh: 他们开始向德克萨斯州议会抱怨。

sentences.en: They start complaining to the Texas Railroad Commission, which is the energy regulator in the state.
sentences.zh: 他们开始向德克萨斯州铁路委员会抱怨，那是该州的能源监管机构。

sentences.en: And they start complaining to conservative activists, groups like the Texas Public Policy Foundation.
sentences.zh: 他们开始向保守派活动人士抱怨，比如德克萨斯公共政策基金会这样的组织。

sentences.en: All of these major influential forces in Texas start hearing their concerns.
sentences.zh: 所有这些在德克萨斯州有影响力的力量都开始倾听他们的担忧。

sentences.en: And in 2020,
a bill emerges in the Texas legislature and is signed by Governor Greg Abbott that essentially says the state needs to stop doing business with financial firms that are,
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州议会出台了一项法案，并由格雷格·阿博特州长签署，该法案本质上要求该州停止与那些，

sentences.en: quote unquote, boycotting fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 所谓“抵制”化石燃料的金融公司开展业务。

sentences.en: That is, companies that have made it their mission to reduce their exposure to oil and gas, which is, of course, the biggest industry in Texas.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，那些以减少对石油和天然气敞口为使命的公司，而这当然是德克萨斯州最大的产业。

sentences.en: The Texas state legislature says, well, if you are going to stop doing business with us, we're going to stop doing business with you.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州议会说，好吧，如果你要停止与我们做生意，我们也要停止与你做生意。

sentences.en: And this bill is essentially designed to punish companies that are pursuing the E in ESG.
sentences.zh: 这项法案本质上旨在惩罚那些追求ESG中“E”的公司。

sentences.en: And what does punishing companies that are worried about the E and ESG actually look like once this bill is signed into law?
sentences.zh: 那么，在该法案签署成为法律后，惩罚那些担心ESG中“E”的公司实际上是什么样子的？

sentences.en: Well, it proved a little hard to implement it, but just this past August, the Texas comptroller indeed came out with an initial list of financial institutions that it deemed were,
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实证明实施起来有点困难，但就在去年八月，德克萨斯州审计长确实发布了一份初步的金融机构名单，认为它们，

sentences.en: quote unquote, boycotting fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 所谓“抵制”化石燃料。

sentences.en: And it set in motion a process of actually pulling billions of dollars of state money,
sentences.zh: 这启动了一个程序，实际上撤回了数十亿美元的州政府资金，

sentences.en: funds held by the retirement accounts of teachers and firefighters and police officers out of some of the most mainstream investment vehicles available on the market today.
sentences.zh: 即教师、消防员和警察的养老金账户持有的资金，撤出了当今市场上一些最主流的投资工具。

sentences.en: Companies like BlackRock and Credit Suisse.
sentences.zh: 像贝莱德和瑞士信贷这样的公司。

sentences.en: And is that actually in the financial interest of either Texas or its retirees and pensioners?
sentences.zh: 这真的符合德克萨斯州或其退休人员和养老金领取者的经济利益吗？

sentences.en: Not necessarily.
sentences.zh: 不一定。

sentences.en: These big financial institutions are big because they're good at what they do.
sentences.zh: 这些大型金融机构之所以强大，是因为他们擅长自己的业务。

sentences.en: And as a result, they often have lower fee structures.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们通常有较低的费用结构。

sentences.en: They tend to have pretty good returns over time.
sentences.zh: 他们往往能长期保持相当不错的回报。

sentences.en: And in fact,
sentences.zh: 事实上，

sentences.en: there's been a flurry of studies over the last couple of months that show that in states like Texas that do stop doing business with big mainstream financial institutions,
sentences.zh: 过去几个月里出现了一系列研究，表明在像德克萨斯州这样停止与大型主流金融机构合作的州，

sentences.en: they are likely to incur hundreds of millions of dollars in additional fees by working with smaller players on Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 他们很可能会因为与华尔街规模较小的参与者合作而产生数亿美元的额外费用。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So this backlash starts in Texas with these wounded oilmen not getting their loans.
sentences.zh: 所以这场反弹始于德克萨斯州，起因是那些受伤的石油商拿不到贷款。

sentences.en: It escalates to the Texas legislature and the Texas governor.
sentences.zh: 它升级到了德克萨斯州议会和德克萨斯州州长层面。

sentences.en: How much bigger does it become than Texas?
sentences.zh: 它比德克萨斯州的影响范围扩大了多少？

sentences.en: This has become a truly national movement.
sentences.zh: 这已经成为一场真正的全国性运动。

sentences.en: So very quickly, something called ESG has become one of the most destructive forces in the American economy.
sentences.zh: 所以很快，所谓的ESG已成为美国经济中最具破坏性的力量之一。

sentences.en: About a half dozen states have passed very, very similar laws.
sentences.zh: 大约有六个州通过了非常、非常相似的法律。

sentences.en: West Virginia today announcing that it is severing ties with five financial institutions that the Treasury there deems as being discriminatory towards certain industries.
sentences.zh: 西弗吉尼亚州今天宣布，它正在切断与五家金融机构的联系，该州财政部认为这些机构对某些行业存在歧视。

sentences.en: The state of Louisiana is pulling nearly $800 million from BlackRock, says its, quote, blatantly anti-fossil fuel policies would destroy Louisiana's economy.
sentences.zh: 路易斯安那州正在从贝莱德撤出近8亿美元，称其所谓的“公然反化石燃料政策”将摧毁路易斯安那州的经济。

sentences.en: Other states, including West Virginia and Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 其他州，包括西弗吉尼亚州和路易斯安那州。

sentences.en: By the way, Kentucky is a fossil fuel producing state.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，肯塔基州是一个化石燃料生产州。

sentences.en: It's joining a growing number of states saying no to woke capitalism.
sentences.zh: 它正在加入越来越多的州，对觉醒资本主义说不。

sentences.en: It's West Virginia, also Florida, Texas, Utah.
sentences.zh: 西弗吉尼亚州是这样，佛罗里达州、德克萨斯州、犹他州也是如此。

sentences.en: Have pulled hundreds of millions of dollars out of funds managed by companies like BlackRock.
sentences.zh: 已经从贝莱德（BlackRock）等公司管理的基金中撤出了数亿美元。

sentences.en: BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, J.P.
sentences.zh: 贝莱德、高盛、摩根大通（J.P.）。

sentences.en: Morgan, Morgan Stanley, and Wells Fargo.
sentences.zh: 摩根士丹利和富国银行。

sentences.en: This is a growing movement in pushback against ESG and woke capitalism.
sentences.zh: 这是一场针对ESG（环境、社会和治理）和“觉醒资本主义”的日益增长的抵制运动。

sentences.en: And we've seen dozens of conservative legislatures around the country push bills like this.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到全国各地几十个保守派立法机构都在推动类似的法案。

sentences.en: For us, it just does not make sense.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，这根本说不通。

sentences.en: We're not going to pay for our own destruction, right?
sentences.zh: 我们不会为自己的毁灭买单，对吧？

sentences.en: Even in democratic states where they are unlikely to pass at this very moment.
sentences.zh: 即使是在目前不太可能通过此类法案的民主党州也是如此。

sentences.en: It is truly a big and growing national trend right now.
sentences.zh: 这确实是目前全国范围内一个巨大且不断增长的趋势。

sentences.en: Every state in this country still has massive fossil fuel businesses operating today.
sentences.zh: 这个国家的每个州至今仍有庞大的化石燃料企业在运营。

sentences.en: And the conservative legislatures see it as part of their mission to defend those companies.
sentences.zh: 而保守派立法机构将其视为捍卫这些公司使命的一部分。

sentences.en: But what's going on here is actually bigger than just that.
sentences.zh: 但这里发生的事情实际上比这更宏大。

sentences.en: Critics have a much broader set of concerns.
sentences.zh: 批评者有着更广泛的担忧。

sentences.en: They see ESG writ large as sort of a Trojan horse that is advancing liberal policy priorities.
sentences.zh: 他们将ESG广义地视为一种“特洛伊木马”，旨在推进自由派的政策优先事项。

sentences.en: Everything from diversity in the workplace to LGBTQ rights to economic policies that don't necessarily focus on the bottom line.
sentences.zh: 从职场多元化到LGBTQ权利，再到不一定关注底线的经济政策，应有尽有。

sentences.en: And that gets to this essential point that the critics of ESG make.
sentences.zh: 这就触及了ESG批评者提出的核心观点。

sentences.en: They say that the point of business, as you said earlier, Michael, is to make money.
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才所说，迈克尔，他们认为商业的目的是为了赚钱。

sentences.en: And that with the rise of ESG, that fundamental imperative, the profit motive, is being loSt.
sentences.zh: 而随着ESG的兴起，那种基本的必要条件——利润动机——正在丧失。

sentences.en: But David, as I recall, the proponents of ESG argue forcefully that this is not just a do-gooderism philosophy.
sentences.zh: 但大卫，我记得ESG的支持者强烈反驳说，这不仅仅是一种“做好事”的哲学。

sentences.en: They say it's a money-making philosophy.
sentences.zh: 他们说这是一种赚钱的哲学。

sentences.en: So do these mostly Republican skeptics and critics of ESG, do they have a point?
sentences.zh: 那么，这些主要是共和党人的ESG怀疑论者和批评者，他们说得有道理吗？

sentences.en: Now that this has been in place across so many companies for a number of years, are they right to question whether it's actually improving financial returns?
sentences.zh: 既然这套体系已经在许多公司实施了多年，他们质疑它是否真的能提高财务回报，这有道理吗？

sentences.en: There are a lot of ESG funds, and there are a lot of ways to slice and dice the time frame on which you measure the profitability of any of these funds.
sentences.zh: ESG基金有很多，衡量这些基金盈利能力的时间跨度也有很多种切分方式。

sentences.en: The upshot is there are studies that conclude that ESG investing is indeed a good bet in the long term.
sentences.zh: 结论是，有研究表明，从长远来看，ESG投资确实是一个不错的选择。

sentences.en: But you only need to look at the markets to understand that if you had divested from all your fossil fuel investments last year,
sentences.zh: 但你只需要看看市场就明白了，如果你去年撤出了所有的化石燃料投资，

sentences.en: when oil and gas companies were some of the major winners because of the war in Ukraine, well, you missed out on a big market upswing.
sentences.zh: 而当时石油和天然气公司因为乌克兰战争成为了主要赢家，那么，你就错失了一波巨大的市场行情。

sentences.en: And that is really proof positive to critics that ESG is just not good business practice at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 对于批评者来说，这确实是ESG归根结底不是良好商业实践的铁证。

sentences.en: Okay, well, let's turn to the other significant critique here, which is that ESGs are a kind of liberal Trojan horse.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们转向这里的另一个重要批评，即ESG是一种自由派的“特洛伊木马”。

sentences.en: Help me understand what exactly Republicans fear.
sentences.zh: 帮我理解一下共和党人到底在担心什么。

sentences.en: Do they fear that at this point ESG has become so popular that companies are being pressured into doing it, even if they don't want to, so that they can get the proper ratings?
sentences.zh: 他们是否担心ESG目前已经变得如此流行，以至于公司即使不想做，为了获得适当的评级，也不得不被迫参与其中？

sentences.en: Is that a fear?
sentences.zh: 这是一种担忧吗？

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And beyond that, they would say that many of the CEOs of America's largest companies
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他们还会说，美国许多大公司的首席执行官

sentences.en: have really adopted what they see as a progressive political agenda that they are trying to implement.
sentences.zh: 实际上已经采纳了他们眼中的进步派政治议程，并试图将其付诸实施。

sentences.en: They look at companies protesting President Trump's immigration policies.
sentences.zh: 他们看到公司抗议特朗普总统的移民政策。

sentences.en: They look at companies doing things like objecting to abortion bans in different states.
sentences.zh: 他们看到公司做一些反对不同州堕胎禁令之类的事情。

sentences.en: And they see the business world, corporate America, effectively, in their minds, acting as a proxy for the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，商业世界、美国企业界实际上是在充当民主党的代理人。

sentences.en: And that's why this whole movement has gone beyond state houses to Congress, where just a couple weeks ago, Republicans in the House and then Republicans in the Senate,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么整个运动已经从州议会蔓延到了国会。就在几周前，众议院的共和党人和参议院的共和党人，

sentences.en: joined by a couple Democratic senators, passed a bill that would prevent the people that invest retirement funds on behalf of federal workers
sentences.zh: 在几位民主党参议员的加入下，通过了一项法案，旨在阻止那些代表联邦雇员投资退休基金的人

sentences.en: from considering ESG factors when making their investment decisions.
sentences.zh: 在做出投资决策时考虑ESG因素。

sentences.en: And so that's, of course, how we get to Joe Biden promising to veto this bill, which we touched on at the beginning of our conversation, right?
sentences.zh: 当然，这就是为什么乔·拜登承诺否决这项法案，我们在对话开始时也提到了这一点，对吧？

sentences.en: Not what we had on our bingo cards.
sentences.zh: 这可不在我们的预料之中。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And why has the president said that he's going to veto this?
sentences.zh: 那么总统为什么要说他要否决这项法案呢？

sentences.en: Because it certainly sounds like Biden putting his seal of approval on ESG as a philosophy.
sentences.zh: 因为这听起来确实像是拜登在为ESG这一哲学背书。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I think it's important to remember two things at the same time here.
sentences.zh: 我认为同时记住两点很重要。

sentences.en: I think the Biden administration in vetoing this rule is essentially backing the status quo in the financial industry.
sentences.zh: 我认为拜登政府否决这项规则，本质上是在支持金融行业的现状。

sentences.en: This whole apparatus of corporations and ratings agencies and fund managers that are invested in ESG and that are arguing that it is a good long-term investment.
sentences.zh: 整个由企业、评级机构和基金经理组成的体系，他们投资于ESG，并主张这是一种良好的长期投资。

sentences.en: But it's impossible not to also remember that that whole apparatus is largely supporting policy priorities that are in line with the Biden administration's own political agenda.
sentences.zh: 但同样不可忽视的是，整个体系在很大程度上支持着与拜登政府自身政治议程相一致的政策优先事项。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I can't help thinking that a Democratic president's promise to veto a bill that would reign in ESG
sentences.zh: 我不禁想到，一位民主党总统承诺否决一项旨在限制ESG的法案，

sentences.en: is only going to further antagonize the critics of ESG who think it's truly just doing the handiwork of the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 只会进一步激怒那些认为ESG实际上只是在为民主党效力的批评者。

sentences.en: I think you're right.
sentences.zh: 我想你是对的。

sentences.en: But I also think we need to return to this moment just after the financial crisis when the reputations of big business and Wall Street in particular were so tarnished.
sentences.zh: 但我也认为我们需要回到金融危机刚结束的那一刻，当时大企业，尤其是华尔街的声誉受到了极大的损害。

sentences.en: And many people viewed big business at large as sort of morally bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为大企业在很大程度上在道德上已经破产了。

sentences.en: The response over the last 15 years or so has been this increased engagement in political, social, and sometimes highly controversial issues by the biggest CEOs in the country.
sentences.zh: 过去15年左右的反应是，国内最大的首席执行官们越来越多地参与到政治、社会以及有时极具争议的问题中来。

sentences.en: That has gotten to a point now where politicians, especially on the right, are essentially questioning whether it's really CEOs who we want to be listening to.
sentences.zh: 现在已经到了这样一个地步，政客们，尤其是右翼政客，基本上在质疑我们是否真的想听这些首席执行官的话。

sentences.en: Why, they ask, are we letting CEOs set policy when they are the elected leaders?
sentences.zh: 他们问，既然有民选领导人，为什么我们要让首席执行官制定政策？

sentences.en: So, David, I want to zoom really far out here because at the heart of this whole fight and really at the heart of this whole conversation we're having is a power struggle, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，大卫，我想把视角拉得远一点，因为这场斗争的核心，实际上也是我们正在进行的这场对话的核心，是一场权力斗争，对吧？

sentences.en: Who gets to tell society how to operate, what priorities to emphasize?
sentences.zh: 谁有权告诉社会如何运作，应该强调哪些优先事项？

sentences.en: And it strikes me that for a very long time, Republican elected officials had no problem giving corporations a very significant amount of power in American society.
sentences.zh: 让我印象深刻的是，长期以来，共和党民选官员对于赋予企业在美国社会中相当大的权力并没有任何意见。

sentences.en: And it seems like this worry about giving corporations too much power has really only arrived on Republicans' radar
sentences.zh: 而这种对赋予企业过多权力的担忧，似乎只有在共和党人的雷达上才真正出现，

sentences.en: since those companies began espousing a social agenda at odds with that of the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 那是在这些公司开始支持与共和党议程相左的社会议程之后。

sentences.en: For the longest time, for decades really, Republicans, the GOP, was the party of big business.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，几十年来，共和党（GOP）一直是代表大企业的政党。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think they feel like they've lost this historic and very powerful ally.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们觉得已经失去了这个历史性的、非常强大的盟友。

sentences.en: And some of all of this legislation is reflective of this deep sort of identity crisis that the Republican Party is having as they look to corporate America
sentences.zh: 所有这些立法中的一部分，反映了共和党在审视美国企业界时所经历的这种深刻的身份危机，

sentences.en: and see that some of their most trusted allies for the past generation are suddenly not standing by their side.
sentences.zh: 他们看到过去一代人中最值得信赖的一些盟友突然不再站在他们这一边了。

sentences.en: Which is painful, I have to imagine.
sentences.zh: 我想这一定很痛苦。

sentences.en: I think it's painful.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很痛苦。

sentences.en: I think it's disorienting.
sentences.zh: 我认为这令人困惑。

sentences.en: There was a pretty amazing episode just very recently when Mitch McConnell, the Senate Majority Leader, was asked about the degree to which just how engaged in politics
sentences.zh: 就在最近发生了一件非常令人惊讶的事情，当时参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔被问及企业参与政治的程度，

sentences.en: businesses have become.
sentences.zh: 企业已经变得多么深入政治。

sentences.en: And he said businesses should stay out of politics.
sentences.zh: 他说企业应该远离政治。

sentences.en: And then he was asked, well, should they stop giving money to politicians?
sentences.zh: 然后有人问他，那么，他们应该停止向政客捐款吗？

sentences.en: And he said, well, no, no, not necessarily.
sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，不，不，不一定。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, so that really makes me wonder if what we're witnessing here is a Republican frustration with where corporate winds are now blowing, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这真的让我怀疑，我们在这里所目睹的是共和党对企业风向转变的挫败感，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, if we're talking about $18 trillion of money pouring into these ESG funds, it starts to get hard to see these Republican laws as anything but a kind of protest by people
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果我们谈论的是18万亿美元涌入这些ESG基金，那么很难不把这些共和党法律看作是一种抗议，来自那些

sentences.en: who feel that they have ended up on the losing side of this kind of corporate cultural battle, right?
sentences.zh: 觉得自己在这场企业文化之战中最终处于失败一方的人，对吧？

sentences.en: And I wonder if it's reached a point in the business world where it's kind of impossible to stop ESG, even if Republicans really wanted to.
sentences.zh: 我想知道商业世界是否已经到了即使共和党人真的想阻止ESG也无法阻止的地步。

sentences.en: If you ask the CEO of a big company, as I often do, if all this noise is making an impact on their ESG goals, they will very quickly tell you that they are committed to go a net
sentences.zh: 如果你问一家大公司的首席执行官，正如我经常做的那样，这些噪音是否对他们的ESG目标产生了影响，他们会很快告诉你，他们致力于在未来几十年内实现净零碳排放。

sentences.en: zero carbon emissions in the next couple of decades.
sentences.zh: 他们会告诉你，他们相信多元化的员工队伍是一支健康且富有成效的队伍。

sentences.en: They will tell you that they believe a diverse workforce is a healthy and productive workforce.
sentences.zh: 而且他们完全支持良好的治理。

sentences.en: And they are all for good governance.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他们通常会私下告诉你，如果他们再也不用说“ESG”这个词，他们会非常乐意。

sentences.en: In the same breath, they will tell you, off the record usually, that if they never have to say the word ESG again, they would be totally fine with that.
sentences.zh: 整个辩论已经变成了一种政治负担，他们并不一定喜欢每天处理这些问题，

sentences.en: This whole debate has become a political liability that they don't necessarily like dealing with
sentences.zh: 即使他们继续从根本上相信其中许多优先事项是长远来看正确的事情。

sentences.en: every day, even as they continue to fundamentally believe in a lot of these priorities as the right thing to do in the long term.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论两年后我们是否还称其为ESG，这些政策优先事项在短期内都不会消失。

sentences.en: So whether or not we call it ESG two years from now, these policy priorities are not going anywhere anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 好的，大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Well, David, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to another day.
sentences.zh: 周日晚上，联邦监管机构批准了一项针对银行业的不同寻常的干预措施，以避免在政府关闭两家区域性银行后引发金融危机。

sentences.en: On Sunday night, federal regulators approved an unusual intervention into the banking industry to avoid a financial crisis after the government shut down two regional banks.
sentences.zh: 此次干预将确保在这两家银行拥有资金的每一个人，

sentences.en: The intervention would ensure that everyone with money at the two banks,
sentences.zh: 即硅谷银行和签名银行，都能获得全额偿还，即使他们的存款超过了政府通常承保的25万美元。

sentences.en: Silicon Valley Bank and Signature Bank, would be paid back in full, even if their deposits exceeded the $250,000 normally insured by the government.
sentences.zh: 这是疯狂四天的顶点，期间硅谷银行的客户因担心其财务状况，
